title: UI Governance Config
description: Per-repository configuration for the UI schema drift validator.

dbSchema.description: Path to the SQL DDL schema file (relative to repo root).

views.description: Glob pattern for *.ui-schema.yaml contract files, relative to repo root. E.g. specs/078-*/contracts/views/*.ui-schema.yaml

rules.description: Array of governance rule overrides. Omit to use all defaults.

tables.description: Restrict this rule to specific table names.
